scope: isolated ML-KEM-768 dominant-kernel feasibility spike; not product code

timing_environment.note: 64 KiB permits BIOS entry; the image itself is statically checked below the 16 KiB 0x4000 ceiling.

provisional_path_synthetic_kernel_proxy.semantic_scope: dominant-kernel multiset associated with K-PKE.Decrypt plus G(m' || H(ek)); no candidate output

remaining_path_synthetic_kernel_proxy.semantic_scope: remaining Keccak/lattice multiset; serialization, compare, selection, and standard output are omitted

standards_scope.self_precomputation: Architectural scenario only: a future 8088 path would generate its own key and deterministic public A^T matrix before TCP. This benchmark substitutes fixtures and does not implement keygen, matrix generation, media I/O, or cache integrity.

speculate_then_commit.commit_gate: Server Finished is a separate provisional pre-Finished gate. Promotion additionally requires a real selected ML-KEM secret, re-encryption, constant-time c-prime == c, J, implicit-rejection selection, provisional/selected-secret equality, TLS key/IV re-derivation, and pinned server authentication.

omitted_from_dominant_kernel_timing: hash absorb and extract byte work

size.integration_note: The fixture keeps all K=3 operands resident for a clean timing oracle. The 7992-byte content occupies [0x1000,0x2f38), while the loader reads 16 sectors through 0x3000. A 16 KiB product path would have to implement and integrity-bind streaming/overlays; its integrated peak is not measured.

feasibility.relaxed_8_to_9_second_fit: research-plausible only after a full hand-optimized implementation; not demonstrated
feasibility.provisional_candidate_fit: unknown until a standards-complete candidate implementation, representative KAT timing distribution, and integrated TLS path exist
feasibility.remaining_validation_fit_with_liveness: unknown; byte/FO operations, cache I/O, and target integration are omitted
feasibility.timing_sample_scope: Each value is one N=1 BIOS-tick observation on synthetic fixtures; tick quantization and operand-dependent 8088 IMUL timing prevent treating it as a bound.
feasibility.reason: The isolated dominant kernels justify an integrated experiment. They neither produce a provisional candidate nor perform standards-complete decapsulation, so they do not yet establish a pre- or post-Finished fit.

optimization_comparator.warning: These are not 8088 measurements or bounds. The MSP430 lattice assembly uses a dedicated hardware multiplier absent on the 8088; even the optimistic projection exceeds the strict 5.6-second remainder before omitted work.

conclusion: A future same-machine matrix precomputation path is worth implementing and would preserve the no-external-machine invariant. The cached dominant-kernel proxy already totals 10.8752 seconds before omitted work, so standards-complete ML-KEM-768 decapsulation is not credible inside the observed first-handshake span with this portable approach. The 1.4830- and 9.3922-second rows are synthetic kernel proxies, not candidate/validation implementations. They justify only an integrated, adversarial, representative-KAT experiment; provisional use would remain outside FIPS decapsulation.
